wild.title: The Runaway Kite — Original Characters
wild.script:
[Use exactly the saved original duo @Little-Wild-Adventures-Meerkat-and-Bird, BOTH present. Same cyan turquoise BLUE bird with blue crest and orange beak, never a yellow bird; same golden brown meerkat. Fully moving 3D scene, bright meadow. Text THE RUNAWAY KITE readable over moving scene for 2.5 seconds.] Milo the meerkat had a brilliant idea. Today, his best friend Pip would help fly the biggest leaf-shaped kite in the meadow.
[Same @Little-Wild-Adventures-Meerkat-and-Bird blue-bird duo, unmodified identity, smooth dynamic tracking camera and animated feet, wings, and grass.] The kite lifted into the breeze. Pip flew beside it, cheering, while Milo ran happily through the flowers.
[Same @Little-Wild-Adventures-Meerkat-and-Bird. Small vivid BLUE bird, not yellow. A sudden gust steals the kite; both characters react with expressive animation.] But whoosh! A playful gust snatched the string from Milo's paws. The kite sailed over a duck pond!
[Same @Little-Wild-Adventures-Meerkat-and-Bird. Original blue bird flies and golden brown meerkat runs across a bridge; dynamic 3D animation.] Follow me, Pip chirped. The two friends raced across a little bridge as curious ducks watched.
[Same @Little-Wild-Adventures-Meerkat-and-Bird. Blue bird and golden brown meerkat at apple tree, smooth full-motion animation.] The kite snagged in an apple tree. Milo jumped twice, but he couldn't reach it. Pip had an idea.
[Same @Little-Wild-Adventures-Meerkat-and-Bird. Original CYAN BLUE bird carefully grabs the string with orange beak, never change body color.] With one brave swoop, Pip lifted the string gently. Milo caught it and grinned.
[Same @Little-Wild-Adventures-Meerkat-and-Bird. Preserve exact reference image identities; happy bright moving conclusion.] Together, they held the kite safely. It soared again. Milo hugged his little blue friend. The best adventures, he decided, are the ones you share!
wild.releaseGuard: Do not submit to YouTube without checking old yellow-bird version and final visual character consistency.

dogs.title: What If Dogs Could Talk? — Full Dialogue Edition
dogs.script:
[Live fully animated 3D family comedy, 9:16. Two separate talking dogs with visually different and natural mouths: golden retriever Biscuit with warm deeper voice, black-white border collie Pixel with high playful voice. Lips move ONLY while own character speaks, not a still image. Title WHAT IF DOGS COULD TALK? readable 2.5 seconds over moving animation.] Biscuit the retriever barked, then spoke. Hey Pixel, have you noticed that humans fetch the ball for us?
[Pixel border collie visibly talks with lips moving and Biscuit listens, sunny garden. Moving 3D animation, close-ups and gestures.] Pixel laughed. They throw it, we bring it back, and somehow they think WE are the ones being trained!
[Golden retriever Biscuit talking with visible synced mouth movement, border collie listening. Both tails wag.] Biscuit grinned. Mine says we need exercise. Then he walks around carrying a bag full of my snacks!
[Black-and-white Pixel speaks as Biscuit reacts, cinematic moving family 3D.] Pixel chuckled. I sit for two seconds, and they call me a genius. They give me a treat just for waiting!
[Golden Biscuit visibly speaks, Pixel listens, bright fun motion.] Biscuit whispered. Should we tell them that we can talk? Imagine all the trouble we could get into.
[Pixel talks, mouth moving, Biscuit reacts. They share a mischievous expression, happy ending with animated human.] Pixel winked. Not before dinner! Both dogs laughed while their human scratched their ears. Maybe humans were the clever ones after all.
dogs.releaseGuard: Do not publish unless >=35 seconds, moving clips, lip sync and two voices are verified.
